jobs.title: Senior Associate, Strategic Program Management
jobs.description:
Playing an essential role in the U.S. economy, Fannie Mae is foundational to housing finance. Here, your expertise can help fuel purpose-driven innovation that expands access to homeownership and affordable rental housing across the country. Join Fannie Mae to grow your career and help people find a place to call home.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and business-oriented Senior Associate, Strategic Program Management.   As a valued colleague on our team, you will support the planning, execution, and delivery of enterprise strategic initiatives. This role partners closely with leaders across Finance, Marketing, Product, Operations, and other business functions to translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, monitor program performance, and provide data-driven insights that enable informed decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines structured problem-solving, strong analytical skills, and program management capabilities with the ability to influence cross-functional teams. They are comfortable navigating ambiguity, synthesizing complex information, and developing executive-ready recommendations that advance strategic business objectives.

THE IMPACT YOU WILL MAKE
The Senior Associate, Strategic Program Management role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:
- Support the planning, execution, and coordination of cross-functional strategic initiatives aligned with enterprise priorities.

- Partner with business leaders to translate strategic objectives into actionable program plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

- Coordinate activities across multiple workstreams, proactively managing dependencies, timelines, risks, and competing priorities.

- Monitor program progress, identify risks and issues, and recommend mitigation strategies to maintain successful delivery.

- Prepare executive-ready status updates, presentations, decision materials, and communications for program leadership and governance forums.

- Support program governance by maintaining action logs, decision trackers, and performance reporting.

Strategic Planning & Business Analysis
- Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to support strategic initiatives, business priorities, and organizational transformation efforts.

- Develop business cases, scenario analyses, and strategic recommendations using financial, operational, customer, and market insights.

- Evaluate program performance and business outcomes, identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

- Perform ad hoc analyses that inform executive decision-making and long-term strategic planning.

- Synthesize complex information into concise, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

Performance Monitoring
- Develop and maintain reporting that tracks strategic initiatives, program milestones, key performance indicators, and business outcomes.

- Monitor progress against strategic objectives and provide insights into performance drivers, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.

- Support leadership with recurring reporting and executive dashboards that communicate program health and organizational progress.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Partner with Finance, Marketing, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and other stakeholders to drive alignment and execution.

- Facilitate collaboration across teams to resolve dependencies, remove obstacles, and maintain momentum on strategic initiatives.

- Build trusted relationships across the organization while influencing outcomes without direct authority.

- Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences, tailoring messages to stakeholder needs.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to strengthen program governance, planning processes, and execution methodologies.

- Recommend improvements to performance measurement, reporting, and strategic planning processes.

- Contribute to the evolution of strategic program management best practices across the organization.

THE EXPERIENCE YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

Required Experience:
- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Management, Engineering, or a related field.

- At least 2 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, strategic program management, business transformation, or business operations.

- Experience supporting cross-functional strategic initiatives from planning through implementation.

- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex information into actionable business recommendations.

- Experience preparing executive presentations, status updates, and strategic communications.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

- Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.

Desired Experiences:
- Experience in financial services, mortgage lending, banking, or fintech.

- Experience supporting enterprise transformation or strategic initiatives.

- Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery methodologies.

- Experience developing executive business cases, strategic recommendations, and governance materials.

- Exposure to program management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or Microsoft Project.

What Will Make You Successful:
We're looking for someone who:
- Thinks strategically while maintaining strong execution discipline.

- Breaks down complex business challenges into structured, actionable solutions.

- Uses data and analysis to support sound business decisions.

- Builds trusted relationships across functions and influences without direct authority.

- Communicates clearly and confidently with leaders at all levels.

- Demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a continuous improvement mindset.

- Balances strategic thinking with attention to detail and operational execution.

- Thrives in an environment where priorities evolve and collaboration is essential.

- Takes ownership and consistently delivers high-quality work.

Core Competencies:
- Strategic Planning

- Strategic Program Management

- Business Analysis

- Executive Communication

- Stakeholder Management

- Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Structured Problem Solving

- Program Governance

- Risk & Issue Management

- Business Case Development

- Change Management

- Organizational Agility

#LI-Hybrid

Qualifications
Actionable Insights, Alteryx, Analytics Strategy, Business Analytics, Business Insights, Business Intelligence (BI), Business Strategies, Collaboration, Data Analytics, Key Performance Indicators (KPI), Market Research, Market Strategy, Product Lifecycle, Product Management, Product Strategies, Tableau (Software), Technical Acumen
Education:
Bachelor's Level Degree (Required)

jobs.title: Lead Associate, Strategy & Insights Single Family Policy, Product & Guide Team
jobs.description:
Playing an essential role in the U.S. economy, Fannie Mae is foundational to housing finance. Here, your expertise can help fuel purpose-driven innovation that expands access to homeownership and affordable rental housing across the country. Join Fannie Mae to grow your career and help people find a place to call home.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Lead Associate, Strategy & Insights to join Fannie Mae's Policy, Product & Guide organization within Single-Family.

As a valued colleague on our team, you will lead strategic analysis that helps shape product, policy, digital strategies and priorities. You will work across the organization to turn complex and often ambiguous business questions into structured analyses, actionable insights, and decision-quality recommendations.

The ideal candidate combines structured problem solving, strong quantitative and qualitative analysis, business judgment, and executive communication. You are comfortable starting without a predefined answer or workplan, determining the right analytical approach, working directly with data and research, and influencing stakeholders to move from insight to action. You strengthen team capabilities by improving methodologies and support team development through sharing knowledge, conducting thoughtful peer review, and coaching.

THE IMPACT YOU WILL MAKE

The Lead Associate, Strategy & Insights role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:
- Lead strategic analyses from problem definition through recommendation, translating ambiguous business questions into clear hypotheses, analytical approaches, workplans, and decision-ready conclusions. Analyses could pertain to: policies, products (mortgage, digital, etc), pilots, and other strategic priorities.

- Conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis, including market sizing, opportunity assessments, customer and lender behavior, product adoption and utilization, competitive intelligence, SWOT/right-to-win, market dynamics, and industry and technology trends. Where needed, consult internal stakeholders to inform the strategic recommendations and/or contribute their analyses.

- Synthesize analysis into actionable strategic recommendations, balancing desirability (market opportunity & strategic alignment); viability (value creation, competition, economics); and feasibility (path to execution, risks). Recommendations could inform: product direction, prioritization, and investment decisions

- Strengthen Strategy & Insights capabilities by improving methodologies, standard work, tools, and analytical approaches. Support team development through sharing knowledge, conducting thoughtful peer review, and providing coaching.

THE EXPERIENCE YOU BRING TO THE TEAM
Required Experience:
- At least 4 years of relevant experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, product strategy, business analytics, market intelligence, or a related field.

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Analytics, Strategy, Public Policy, Engineering, or a relate field. MBA preferred.

- Demonstrated ability to independently structure and solve complex business problems, determine the analysis required, and own deliverables from initial problem framing through final recommendation.

- Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, with experience in areas such as market sizing, segmentation, scenario analysis, business cases, competitive analysis, customer insights, or financial analysis.

- Strong business judgment and ability to connect analysis to economics, market impact, operational implications, risk, and strategic rationale.

- Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex information, distinguish what matters most, and develop clear recommendations for senior leaders.

- Strong stakeholder-management skills and experience influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

- Strong written, verbal, and executive communication skills, including advanced proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel.

Desired Experience:
- Experience in mortgage lending, housing finance, banking, financial services, or fintech.

- Understanding of the mortgage origination and underwriting lifecycle and the operational considerations that influence lender adoption and execution.

- Familiarity with Fannie Mae or other investor/agency products, policies, underwriting tools, digital solutions, or Selling Guide requirements.

- Shows curiosity and adaptability in learning and responsibly applying new technologies, including artificial intelligence, to reimagine how we work.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL
We're looking for someone who:
- Creates clarity from ambiguity. Brings structure to complex topics, frames the right questions, and identifies what matters most.

- Demonstrates curiosity. Learns new topics quickly, challenges assumptions, and seeks diverse perspectives to strengthen recommendations.

- Exercises strategic judgment. Balances data, strategic alignment, stakeholder perspectives, and risk to distill insights and form recommendations.

- Communicates with impact. Turns complex analysis into the few insights that matter most and builds a concise, compelling recommendation for leaders.

- Acts with ownership and influence. Anticipates risks and dependencies and moves stakeholders toward outcomes in an environment where priorities evolve.

Core Competencies:
- Strategic Thinking & Structured Problem Solving

- Market Sizing & Opportunity Assessment

- Quantitative & Qualitative Analysis

- Competitive & Market Intelligence

- Digital Product Strategy development

- Business Case Development

- Executive Communication

- Stakeholder Management & Influence

- Cross-Functional Leadership

SF - Product Management - Lead Associate

Qualifications
Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Product Launches, Product Management, Product Strategies, Roadmap Development, Stakeholder Management, Strategy Development
Education:
Bachelor's Level Degree (Required)

jobs.title: Senior Director, Real Estate Portfolio Strategy and Planning
jobs.description:
Playing an essential role in the U.S. economy, Fannie Mae is foundational to housing finance. Here, your expertise can help fuel purpose-driven innovation that expands access to homeownership and affordable rental housing across the country. Join Fannie Mae to grow your career and help people find a place to call home.

Job Description

The Senior Director of Portfolio Strategy and Planning is a strategic leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the long-term vision of Fannie Mae’s corporate real estate portfolio. This role sits within Enterprise Workplace and drives an integrated approach to location strategy, portfolio optimization, and workplace delivery—aligning real estate decisions with business objectives, workforce trends, and financial performance.

In this compelling leadership position, you will oversee end-to-end portfolio planning, including asset strategy, capacity modeling, scenario planning, space planning, and design and construction alignment, while ensuring operational rigor through lease administration and critical date management. This role will directly shape the future of Fannie Mae’s workplace by ensuring the portfolio is agile, cost-effective, and aligned with the evolving needs of the business and its people - positioning Enterprise Workplace as a strategic enabler of enterprise performance.

THE IMPACT YOU WILL MAKE
The Senior Director, Real Estate Portfolio and Planning role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities:

Portfolio Strategy and Long-Range Planning
- Develop and maintain a comprehensive, long-term corporate real estate portfolio roadmap aligned with enterprise strategy and workforce evolution.
- Lead location strategy efforts, including market analysis, site selection, and geographic optimization.
- Establish portfolio optimization strategies that balance cost, flexibility, employee experience, and business continuity.

Asset Strategy and Performance Management
- Define and execute asset-level strategies (retain, exit, reposition, sell/purchase) across owned and leased properties.
- Lead the Development Process for long term assets including site planning, site approvals, ownership strategies, local government development approvals and execution.
- Partner with Finance and HR to drive portfolio performance, capital planning, and cost optimization.
- Monitor market trends and benchmark portfolio performance to inform strategic decisions.

Capacity Modeling and Scenario Planning
- Build and maintain dynamic capacity models that reflect workforce trends, hybrid work strategies, and business growth scenarios that align with the strategic workforce plan
- Lead scenario planning exercises to evaluate portfolio impacts of strategic business decisions (e.g., headcount shifts, M&A, policy changes).
- Provide data-driven insights to senior leadership for informed decision-making.

Space Planning and Workplace Strategy
- Oversee enterprise space planning standards and ensure alignment with workplace experience goals.
- Translate business needs into scalable, flexible space solutions across the portfolio.
- Partner with Workplace Experience teams to ensure space strategies support productivity, culture, and engagement.

Design and Construction Integration
- Ensure alignment between portfolio strategy and design & construction execution.
- Provide strategic oversight for major capital projects, ensuring consistency with long-term portfolio plans.
- Drive standardization and efficiency in design delivery while maintaining high-quality workplace environments.

Lease Administration and Critical Date Management
- Oversee lease administration processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and risk mitigation.
- Manage critical lease dates (renewals, expirations, options) to enable proactive decision-making.
- Partner with Legal and external partners to support lease negotiations and portfolio transactions.

Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration
- Lead and develop a high-performing team across strategy, planning, and portfolio analytics functions.
- Collaborate closely with business units, HR, Finance, Legal, and Workplace Experience leaders.
- Build multi-dimensional business cases demonstrating the financial, business, employee, customer and risk impacts of location and asset recommendations
- Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on real estate strategy and portfolio decisions.

THE EXPERIENCE YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

Minimum Required Experiences and Skills
- 8 years of experience in corporate real estate, real estate portfolio strategy, or related field.
- Proven experience leading enterprise-level portfolio strategy and planning functions.
- Experience in repositioning real estate assets in the portfolio including sale and purchase with deep knowledge of the development, zoning, permitting, infrastructure and legal requirements.
- Deep expertise in location strategy, capacity modeling, and portfolio optimization.
- Strong financial acumen, including capital planning and lease analysis.
- People leadership experience, including direct management or supervision of a team.
- Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives.
- Shows curiosity and adaptability in learning and responsibly applying new technologies, including artificial intelligence, to reimagine how we work.
- Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into actionable plans.
- Data-driven decision maker with strong analytical rigor.
- Influential communicator capable of engaging senior executives.
- Collaborative leader who thrives in matrixed organizations.
- Change agent who can drive transformation across the workplace ecosystem.

Desired Experience
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.
- 12 years of experience in corporate real estate, real estate portfolio strategy, or related field.
- Experience in financial services or highly regulated environments.
- Familiarity with hybrid workplace strategies and evolving workforce models.
- Advanced analytical and modeling capabilities (e.g., scenario planning tools, portfolio analytics platforms).
- Experience with AI applications for portfolio modeling.
